title: A glass object that refracts the page itself and travels between section anchors
summary: The page's words and hairlines repainted into a square 2D canvas around the glass; a back-face normal pass at 0.6 DPR; two-surface refraction sampled at 12 wavelengths (6 on touch) weighted into RGB; Fresnel over an analytic soft-box studio; section anchors weighted by the middle band, followed on a spring k 46
variants: Any mesh: a lathe-turned lens ([recipe:gl-lathe-turned-object]) or a loaded glb, with the same back-normal pass
html2canvas or a server-rendered image as the back texture when the page under the glass is not plain text
